name: hud_ui_cycle_selector_widget_set_visible_range
description: HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::SetVisibleRange applies a valid first/one-past-last range and clamps the selected index into that range.
known_limits: tier S verification remains pending for the coherent HudUiCycleSelectorWidget source/table cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4b7f80 validates accepted first and one-past-last values against itemCount, then clamps selectedIndex below first up to first and selectedIndex at or beyond one-past-last down to one-past-last - 1.
